name: abba-fiji
description: Register brain sections to atlases with ABBA in Fiji, driven by your assistant
long_description: Starts ABBA (Aligning Big Brains and Atlases) in a pinned Fiji the first time it is needed, and lets the assistant run ABBA's commands, look at rendered snapshots and save the session as a replayable Groovy pipeline. Bundles version-matched documentation. Experimental (codename sextant).

headless.title: Run Fiji without a window
headless.description: Off: ABBA opens its window so you can follow and take over. On: no window (servers, remote machines).

tools.name: fiji_module_search
tools.description: Find SciJava commands and scripts whose title, menu path, description or class contain all the words of the query

tools.name: fiji_module_describe
tools.description: Describe a module's inputs and outputs (types, labels, descriptions, defaults and choices after its initializers ran), the live objects that can fill its object inputs, and the artifact that provides it (provided_by: groupId:artifactId:version)

tools.name: fiji_module_run
tools.description: Run a module (command class, menu path, title, or the path of a script file) with inputs as a JSON object, e.g. {"sigma": 2, "image": "blobs.gif"}

tools.name: fiji_module_status
tools.description: Follow a run started by fiji_module_run: waits up to wait_seconds (default 60) and returns its result, or 'running'

tools.name: fiji_objects
tools.description: The live objects Fiji holds (images, viewers, sessions...): without a type, the number of objects per type; with a type, the objects of that type by the names module inputs accept

tools.name: fiji_module_script
tools.description: The successful fiji_module_run calls of this session as a Groovy script that replays them, every input explicit (modules declaring record=false, which only look, are left out)

tools.name: fiji_ui_windows_read
tools.description: List visible AWT and Swing windows, including titles, classes, bounds, active state, and modality

tools.name: fiji_ui_dialogs_read
tools.description: List visible AWT and Swing dialogs, including each dialog's title, messages, buttons, and modal state

tools.name: fiji_ui_dialog_respond
tools.description: Click an exact enabled button in one visible dialog

tools.name: abba_window_picture
tools.description: Picture of one Fiji window as it is drawn, what the user sees in it: right even when the window is covered or the screen is locked, and never another application

tools.name: abba_docs_search
tools.description: Search the bundled ABBA documentation (guides, one file per command, scripting, examples) with a regular expression; returns matching lines with their file

tools.name: abba_docs_read
tools.description: Read one bundled documentation file, by its path relative to the docs folder (as abba_docs_search gives it)
